design.summary: Settings.blocked_domains (comma-separated) parsed into a frozenset; validate_target_url rejects blocked hosts and subdomains at creation; the redirect route re-checks the destination on every request, after the cache lookup, returning 410.

adr.title: ADR-004: Config-based denylist, enforced at create and redirect
adr.context: Customers reported phishing links behind our domain. The request ('more secure and faster') was ambiguous; scope was agreed via signed-off defaults and a later product-owner clarification.
adr.decision: Operator-managed domain denylist with subdomain matching; checked on every redirect so existing links are disabled immediately
adr.consequences: No schema change; status codes already in the contract. A bad denylist entry disables links until removed (reversible).

design.test_strategy: Unit tests for parsing and matching; integration tests for create and for redirects of pre-existing and cached links

decisions.rationale: Cached links must also be blocked immediately
